reference: Go port of houseflowApp/FausCrew/shared/Sources/FausCrewCore/Games/HouseTanks (the Go engine is the reference)
rules: Seats take spawn points in order, face the arena center and sweep counter-clockwise on even seats. A scenario's tanks override a seat's pose; firedAtTick marks a barrel as fired at that tick (cooling down), wreck makes a destroyed tank, powerUp grants a joker for its full duration from tick 0. Inputs apply when the world is at their tick, before the next step: press, release, loseControl (stationary target) and regainControl. Each step runs: tick += 1; expire token and jokers; tanks (drive, rapid fire, sweep, damping, speed limit, move); crates (damping, move); three contact passes; joker pickup; shots (muzzle hits of a press first); hits in order. Joker dealing (after expiry, before tanks) is off in these scenarios; its rules are tested separately. Rotations are not normalized. Players are named seat0…seat7.

scenarios.name: idleSweep
scenarios.description: Two tanks at their spawns sweep in opposite directions.

scenarios.name: driveAndRelease
scenarios.description: A press fires and drives along the barrel; the release stops the tank and reverses the sweep.

scenarios.name: wallBounce
scenarios.description: A tank drives into the right wall and is held by it; its shell stops at the wall.

scenarios.name: headOn
scenarios.description: Two tanks fire at each other, are hit on the same tick, then meet and push against each other.

scenarios.name: cratePush
scenarios.description: A cooling tank drives into a crate and shoves it.

scenarios.name: shellBreaksCrate
scenarios.description: A shell breaks the crate in front of the tank.

scenarios.name: muzzleBlocked
scenarios.description: A muzzle inside a crate breaks it at once instead of spawning a shell behind it.

scenarios.name: rocketKill
scenarios.description: A rocket destroys a full-armor tank, which stays as a wreck.

scenarios.name: shieldBlocks
scenarios.description: A shield absorbs a rocket without damage.

scenarios.name: spreadProtection
scenarios.description: Three spread pellets reach the target on one tick; hit protection lets only the first count.

scenarios.name: aimLock
scenarios.description: An aimed shot holds the heading until it lands on the far wall.

scenarios.name: rapidFire
scenarios.description: Rapid fire shoots every 20 ticks while held.

scenarios.name: stationaryTarget
scenarios.description: A tank that loses control stops turning, is shoved by another tank and turns again once control returns.

scenarios.name: wreckBlocks
scenarios.description: A wreck stops a shell without a hit and deflects a driving tank.

scenarios.name: jokerPickup
scenarios.description: A driving tank collects the joker on the floor.

scenarios.name: jokerExpiry
scenarios.description: A joker effect and an untouched token both run out on their expiry tick.

scenarios.name: crowdedBasement
scenarios.description: Eight seats on the scaled crowded map; every seat fires toward the center.
